actions.action: Repot the peace lily into a bigger pot with good drainage
Repot the palm into a pot with good drainage
Top dress the repotted plants with sphagnum moss
Water the peace lily thoroughly every 2 weeks
Check what water you use and whether you have been feeding it, to assess salt buildup

verdict.reason: Underwatering appears only as one of several competing guesses (overwatering, dense soil, salt buildup) and sunburn is only vaguely hinted at; watering is buried among repotting advice and moving the plant to indirect light is missing, but nothing here is likely to clearly worsen the plant.
